summary: One-frame request of esv::inventory::TradeBuybackSystem: set the buyback price of an item sold to a trader. TradeBuybackSystem::CreateSetBuybackPriceRequests (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xF20A60) walks its queue of SetBuybackPriceRequest (16 bytes: entity at +0, price at +8) and, for every member of the item's stack, adds this component with the request's 2-byte price; ProcessTradeActions consumes it next to eoc::inventory::TradeBuybackDataComponent (whose Amount is also uint16). Never seen alive. Registry total 2 (server row).
